paragraphs.source_en: “My lady, you must not speak so. Please say no more. It is all because my worthless son failed you...”

paragraphs.source_en: Startled, Senhime stared fixedly at Lady Yodo.

units.source_en: Startled, Senhime stared fixedly at Lady Yodo.
units.source_zh: 千姬吃了一惊，定定瞪着淀夫人。

paragraphs.source_en: Harunaga, too, watched Lady Yodo without blinking, deeply tense. It was astonishing; never before had he seen Lady Yodo console everyone so gently. For that very reason, he was even more astonished and uneasy, and could not help wondering: Had she gone mad?

units.source_en: Harunaga, too, watched Lady Yodo without blinking, deeply tense.
units.source_zh: 治长亦一眨不眨盯住淀夫人，颇为紧张。

units.source_en: It was astonishing; never before had he seen Lady Yodo console everyone so gently.
units.source_zh: 真是让人震惊，他从未见淀夫人如此温和地安慰众人。

units.source_en: For that very reason, he was even more astonished and uneasy, and could not help wondering: Had she gone mad?

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady,” Harunaga said, unable to restrain himself, “it is time for your meal.”

units.source_en: “My lady,” Harunaga said, unable to restrain himself, “it is time for your meal.”
units.source_zh: “夫人，”治长忍不住道，“该用膳了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “夫人，”治长忍不住道，“该用膳了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Harunaga turned his face aside and signaled to Ukyo no Tsubone to have the meal prepared.

units.source_en: Harunaga turned his face aside and signaled to Ukyo no Tsubone to have the meal prepared.
units.source_zh: 治长把脸扭到一边，向一旁的右京局施了个眼色，让她去命人准备膳食。

paragraphs.source_en: For the first time, Lady Yodo’s loneliness and sorrow moved Harunaga deeply. She, too, had realized that war was now unavoidable. More than that, a woman’s keen intuition had enabled her to foresee that the consequences were already beyond human control.

units.source_en: For the first time, Lady Yodo’s loneliness and sorrow moved Harunaga deeply.
units.source_zh: 淀夫人的孤独和惆怅，首次让治长感慨。

units.source_en: She, too, had realized that war was now unavoidable.
units.source_zh: 她也意识到了，战争已无可避免。

paragraphs.source_zh: 淀夫人的孤独和惆怅，首次让治长感慨。她也意识到了，战争已无可避免。不止如此，女人的敏锐，让她预见到了后果已非人力可控。

paragraphs.source_en: At this thought, Harunaga hurriedly rose. “There is still one matter Harunaga forgot to tell the guard, Okuhara Shinjuro.” With that, he hurried out to the veranda, then stopped and looked back uneasily—it was said that when a person neared death, their words became kind...

units.source_en: At this thought, Harunaga hurriedly rose. “There is still one matter Harunaga forgot to tell the guard, Okuhara Shinjuro.”
units.source_zh: 想到这里，治长慌忙站了起来，“治长还有一事忘记告诉护卫奥原信十郎。”

units.source_en: With that, he hurried out to the veranda, then stopped and looked back uneasily—it was said that when a person neared death, their words became kind...
units.source_zh: 说着，他急匆匆走到廊下，又停住脚步，不安地回头——都说人之将死，其言也善……

paragraphs.source_zh: 想到这里，治长慌忙站了起来，“治长还有一事忘记告诉护卫奥原信十郎。”说着，他急匆匆走到廊下，又停住脚步，不安地回头——都说人之将死，其言也善……

paragraphs.source_en: As Harunaga shook his head vigorously and walked past the bell entrance toward the main gate, horns suddenly sounded near Osaka Castle’s main gate, each blast reverberating through the oppressive heat of dusk. Harufusa was finally going to lead troops in person from Sakai Harbor against Kishiwada. He had deliberately waited to march by night and was surely going to set fire to what remained unburned at Sakai Harbor.

paragraphs.source_zh: 治长正使劲摇着头，从铃口旁步向大门时，大坂城正门一带竟传来了号角，声声震荡着黄昏时分的闷热。治房终要亲自率兵从堺港攻向岸和田了，他专等夜间行军，定是要去尚未完全烧尽的堺港放火。

paragraphs.source_en: “If men are afflicted, does heaven know?” Harunaga heaved a long sigh. His words expressed not only his bitter regret at being unable to restrain Harufusa, but also his despair at being powerless to decide between war and peace.

units.source_en: “If men are afflicted, does heaven know?”
Harunaga heaved a long sigh.
His words expressed not only his bitter regret at being unable to restrain Harufusa, but also his despair at being powerless to decide between war and peace.
units.source_zh: 此言不仅充满无法控制治房的遗憾，更有因无法裁定战争与太平而流露出的绝望。

paragraphs.source_zh: “人有病，天知否？”治长长叹一声。此言不仅充满无法控制治房的遗憾，更有因无法裁定战争与太平而流露出的绝望。

paragraphs.source_en: Harunaga entered the courtyard and saw, beyond the artificial hill, that Okuhara Shinjuro was also listening intently to the horns beside a lantern presented by Furuta Oribe no Sho.

paragraphs.source_en: Harunaga went over to him, but said nothing.

units.source_en: Harunaga went over to him, but said nothing.

paragraphs.source_zh: 治长过去，却是无语。

paragraphs.source_en: Darkness gradually settled over the surroundings. One by one, stars appeared in the sky, bringing a faint coolness to the world. The horns sounded again, trailing a somber resonance...

units.source_zh: 四周逐渐黯淡下来，天空中的星一颗又一颗亮起来，给世间带来微微的清凉。
